children: The win probability for the G2 option in a Polymarket submarket tied to the Counter-Strike matchup between G2 and Legacy fell sharply from 62% one hour ago to 43.5%, a drop of 18.5%. According to ChainCatcher, the move occurred in the market for map 1 round handicap: G2 (-3.5) versus Legacy (+3.5) in the FISSURE PLAYGROUND playoffs. The article said related breaking news may have affected the shift.

title: Polymarket G2 Option Drops 18.5% in Counter-Strike Playoff Market
